input.summary: Make PB's convenience exit unconditional on 90 days' notice with the exit fee capped at 3 months' Development Costs, and allow SFJ convenience termination only effective at the end of the then-current term on 90 days' notice.
input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the $60 million funding gate and the pre-first-approval cut-off so PB as Customer may terminate for convenience at any time on 90 days' notice, and replaced the 300% multiple with an early-termination fee capped at three (3) months' Development Costs. We also limited SFJ's discretionary exits (§§ 14.2.6 and 14.2.10) to the end of the then-current term on 90 days' notice; this is our fallback position on convenience termination.

ops.oldText: PB may terminate this Agreement at any time after SFJ has paid or incurred a total of $60 million of Development Costs and prior to the date of receipt of the first Regulatory Approval upon [***] prior written notice to SFJ. In the event that PB terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 14.2.2 then in exchange for purchasing the Trial Data Package including the Research Results included therein as set forth in Section 11.1.1.4, PB will pay SFJ, within [***] of the date of termination, an amount equal to three hundred percent (300%) of Development Costs paid or incurred by SFJ prior to such termination.
ops.newText: PB as Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon 90 days' prior written notice to SFJ. In the event that PB terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 14.2.2 then in exchange for purchasing the Trial Data Package including the Research Results included therein as set forth in Section 11.1.1.4, PB will pay SFJ, within [***] of the date of termination, an amount not exceeding three (3) months' Development Costs as the sole early-termination fee.

ops.text: SFJ as Vendor may terminate this Agreement for convenience only effective at the end of the then-current term and only upon 90 days' prior written notice to PB; Sections 14.2.6 and 14.2.10 are limited accordingly.
